construction_protocol.cw: unit signed/unsigned support only after full multiset algebra
construction_protocol.roles: original 1024 signed_delta plus 1024 shared; new joint roles retired

selection_policy.aggregation: First seed/fold within endpoint, then related endpoints within source family, then equal task weights
selection_policy.report: Configuration ranks, standardized within-endpoint regret, seed/fold stability, cost and coverage
selection_policy.representative: User selects a single common preset after analysis; no automatic promotion of test maximum
selection_policy.confirmation: A selected preset needs separately frozen confirmation; the factorial test scores remain exploratory

relation_limits: GDB7 and RDB7 have related source provenance; do not count them as independent families
E2SN2 combines E2 and SN2; within-family averaging avoids duplicate task weight
Cycloadd G_act is represented by primary14 Cyclo only, not double-counted as15 Cycloadd
14 reactant grouped holdouts remain holdouts,15 grouped CV remains CV
population_policy: Frozen native populations and selectors; additional encoding failures are zero vectors, never deleted
